sections.name: Golden homepage
sections.summary: Rounds 16-17 reinvented the editorial sections on one authored split-card family (light editorial half + charcoal generative half): S02 problem as a charcoal fragmentation field, S03 principle as abstract interchangeable-intelligence swap-slots with the rented-brand logos removed for good, S04 as a Build-Run-Break-Refine-Package operating-loop timeline. S05 Operating proof (previously unstyled raw text) was rebuilt into honest charcoal 'Evidence pending' redacted-screen placeholders. S06 AI OS Wings were centred and enlarged and its two bottom cards rebuilt from Olli's reference screenshots (a monochrome orbital diagram + a divided 2x2 Features index). S07 ecosystem cards were simplified to Wings + name + Coming soon (waitlist removed). The family header indent was fixed. verify_homepage_round17.py is the active proof; the locked V01 hero, canonical motion and honest evidence/consent states carry forward and the whole-page gate stays open. Earlier lineage: Round 14 lifts the hero fan higher: the per-card vertical step drops to clamp(12px,1.6vw,24px) (side-card drop 23/46px at 1440) so the cards sit flatter and closer to level with AI OS, with the overlap increased only slightly to clamp(-80px,-5.6vw,-58px). Round 13's compaction, Round 12's canonical card-outline token, Round 11's centred identity with the no-overlay-fork guard, and every other section carry forward unchanged. Living Cores stay on intrinsically sized hosts with canonical Phase A automatic motion, ordinary regions return to one live core, navigation suppresses page motion, exact static twins cover every fallback and evidence remains explicitly pending. After Round 14, Olli provisionally locked the hero (GH-S01) at V01, the five-card arc, following a hero-lab exploration (V01-V19: clean even spreads and auto-advancing single-card carousels, all non-canonical); recorded in round-14-feedback.json and as a heroSectionLock in review.json. No hero code changed; the remaining sections and the whole-page gate stay open. Round 15 splits GH-S04 into 'Built on ourselves first' and 'Operating proof' (ten sections now; AI OS to GH-S06 through footer to GH-S10) and left-aligns the previously indented header; verify_homepage_round15.py proves the split, renumber, unchanged hero and carried-forward contracts.
